info.name: Talk stickers
info.summary: Stickers for Talk, sent from the Smart Picker
info.description:
Send stickers in Talk (and wherever the Smart Picker is offered): open-licensed emoji packs (Fluent Emoji, Noto Emoji, also animated, OpenMoji, Twemoji) and your own, uploaded as images to a shared folder.
A sticker is sent as a link, which Talk shows as the image.
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
